newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans recover as commercials turn buyers.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans recover as commercials turn buyers.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures recovered from earlier losses and were mixed in late dealings as commercials bought the nearbys, traders said.
"We've had enormous gains of late and the bears have been trying to break the market but with very little success," said Vic Lespinasse of Dean Witter.
Traders said Cargill Inc and Iowa Grain each bought 500,000 bushels March in late dealings which helped turn the market around.
Merrill Lynch reportedly bought six million bushels, traders said.

On the fundemental side, meteorologists continued to send conflicting messages about weekend rains in parched Brazilian soybean growing areas. Some said showers would be widespread while others suggested they would be more scattered.
At 1255 CST, soybeans were two cents per bushel higher to 2-1/2 cents lower with March down 1/2 at $7.45.
